jobs.description:
Company Description



NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies.



 Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.



Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.



Job Description



The Senior Creative Producer, Creative Strategy will help shape and bring to life integrated marketing campaigns for some of Telemundo's biggest prime-time scripted, reality, and special programming.



This role is equal parts creative strategist, storyteller, producer and pitch lead. You'll partner across Creative, Marketing, Design, Operations, and external teams to build campaigns that feel culturally relevant, platform-smart, and emotionally connected to Hispanic audiences.



Responsibilities:

• Shape integrated campaign ideas from early strategy through final execution across linear, streaming, digital, social, partnerships, and emerging platforms.

• Partner with Creative Leadership to define the campaign direction, positioning, messaging, and creative approach for each property.

• Build big, clear ideas that can travel across platforms and connect with audiences in culturally relevant ways.

• Lead campaign storytelling, including scripts, messaging frameworks, tone, and visual direction.

• Guide production from concept through pre-production, shoots, post, reviews, finishing, and delivery.

• Balance creative ambition with real-world timelines, budgets, resources, and production needs.

• Pitch ideas and creative work with clarity and confidence to senior leaders and cross-functional partners.

• Lead editors, designers, and creative partners through key projects, keeping the work focused, fresh, and on strategy.

• Connect on-air, off-air, digital, social, experiential, and partnership elements into one cohesive campaign story.

• Partner with Design, Marketing, Operations, and external vendors to keep the work visually distinctive and consistent.

• Push for smart creative risks, fresh formats, and ideas that can stand out in culture and spark conversation.



Qualifications

• 6-8+ years of experience in creative strategy and production for entertainment marketing, television, streaming, or media environments.

• A strong track record of developing and delivering integrated 360° campaigns from idea through execution.

• Sharp creative instincts, strong taste, and the ability to turn a brief into a clear, compelling campaign idea.

• Excellent storytelling skills across writing, scripting, messaging, and visual direction.

• Confidence presenting ideas, decks, creative work, and project updates to senior executives and cross-functional teams.

• Excellent Spanish-language writing and communication skills, with bilingual fluency in Spanish and English.

• Hands-on production experience across scripting, shoots, post-production, finishing, and delivery.

• The ability to manage several high-priority projects at once while staying calm, collaborative, and solutions-oriented.

• A strong understanding of how creative works across linear, streaming, digital, social, branded content, and emerging platforms.

• Experience managing timelines, budgets, creative resources, and external partners.

• Working knowledge of tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Avid Media Composer, PowerPoint, Keynote, and other tools used to develop, produce, and present promotional creative.

• A passion for entertainment, culture, and creating work that connects deeply with Hispanic audiences.



Additional Requirements:

• Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, which currently requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

jobs.title: Visual AI Creative Lead
jobs.description:
Join the Team Building the Future of AI-Powered Visual Creativity

For photographers, visual storytellers, art directors, and creative minds shaping the future of AI.



Aurify LLC — part of a global technology community with 60+ million followers worldwide — is looking for exceptional creative minds to help redefine how people create, transform, and experience photography with artificial intelligence.



We're not building another image generator. We're building a technology that understands why images matter — the emotion, meaning, composition, and creative decisions behind a photograph — so that millions of people can become part of extraordinary visual experiences.



This is not a traditional design role. This is a chance to help build the future of photography in the age of AI.



About The Project: Character Transfer

Unlike traditional face-swap technology, we're not just replacing one face with another.



We're building a system that understands the complete visual story of an image — why a moment feels special, what emotion it communicates, what makes the composition powerful, and what must stay unchanged for the image to keep its meaning.



The goal: when a new person enters an existing scene, it should feel as if they were truly there when the photograph was taken.



Not inserted. Not copied. Belonging.



Who We're Looking For

We need a rare combination of creative intelligence and technical curiosity — someone who sees beyond pixels and can read the emotional core, hidden story, and creative intention behind a photograph.



You may come from photography, filmmaking, advertising, fashion, VFX, digital production, or creative technology. Your background matters less than your ability to understand visual language.



Your Mission

You'll help build the intelligence behind our Character Transfer Engine, focused on three areas.



1. Teaching AI to Understand Visual Stories




Every photograph has creative DNA.
For each template, you'll define:
the story being told
its emotional purpose
the relationship between people and environment
visual hierarchy
what must be preserved
what can adapt


Example




A romantic image isn't just "two people looking at each other" — its true value is connection, anticipation, vulnerability, intimacy, trust.
A travel image isn't just "someone near a landmark" — it's discovery, freedom, adventure, achievement, memory.
AI has to understand that difference.


2. Designing Scalable AI Creative Systems

We're not looking for someone who manually perfects one beautiful image — anyone can do that.



We need people who can help build a system that delivers consistently excellent results across:

thousands of templates




millions of users
every age
every appearance
every body type
every culture
every photography condition


You'll contribute to:




AI workflow design
creative instructions
prompt architecture
transformation logic
quality standards
edge-case analysis
evaluation frameworks


3. Evaluating AI Results Through a Creative Lens

You'll help define what high quality really means by evaluating whether results preserve:




Identity — does the person still feel authentic?
Story — do they naturally belong in the scene?
Emotion — does their expression and body language match the moment?
Physical Reality — lighting, shadows, perspective, camera characteristics, skin texture, anatomy, natural imperfections
Artistic Value — does this look like a real moment that actually happened?


Ideal Background (One or More)

Photography & Visual Storytelling

Professional, commercial, or fashion photographers, photo editors, creative/art directors, cinematographers who understand composition, lighting, emotion, directing people, and visual communication.



Advertising, Fashion & Brand Creative

Experience with advertising campaigns, fashion or luxury brands, creative studios, or commercial productions.

You know great images don't just look beautiful — they communicate ideas.



VFX & Digital Production

Compositing, CGI, motion design, digital production pipelines.

Especially valuable: experience maintaining visual quality across large-scale production.



AI Creative Technology

AI image generation/editing workflows, multimodal AI systems, diffusion models, ComfyUI workflows, advanced prompting, creative automation.

Note: pure prompt-writing experience alone isn't enough — we need people who understand visual intelligence.



What Makes Someone Exceptional Here




The strongest candidates think in multiple dimensions at once.
A photographer asks: "Why does this image create emotion?"
A filmmaker asks: "What story is happening in this moment?"
An art director asks: "What should the audience feel?"
A technologist asks: "How can we make this repeatable at scale?"
The ideal person combines all four.


Who This Role Isn't For

This isn't for someone who only creates attractive AI images or experiments with prompts, or who optimizes a single result manually.



We're looking for people who understand creativity, build systems, and help AI learn the principles behind great photography.



Hiring Challenge

Candidates may be asked to analyze a collection of original photo templates and explain:




what makes each image emotionally powerful
the core story of the image
which elements must be preserved vs. adapted
how to design a system capable of maintaining quality across 500+ different people
The goal isn't one impressive image — it's designing the thinking behind thousands of successful ones.


Why Join Aurify

Your work will be experienced by a global audience of 60+ million people, shaping how they create, share, and experience visual memories.



Most AI tools today generate images from text.



We're building something fundamentally different:



A system that understands existing human creativity and lets anyone become part of meaningful visual stories.



You'll help define how AI understands:

jobs.description: Forbes Advisor is hiring an AI Creative Lead to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct-response marketing, and a hands-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character-locked stills through AI video, lip-sync, and voiceover to editor-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed. The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. You have shipped AI-generated video that ran as paid creative, and you can tell real-ad output from output that just reads as AI. We are a human-led shop that uses AI to move faster without diluting craft. You protect the craft bar rather than lowering it to what the model makes easy, and you stay current with a stack that turns over frequently, treating every tool pick as a short-term decision. RESPONSIBILITIES Own generation end-to-end for paid social and native creative: character-locked stills, AI video, lip-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor-ready footage. Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot. Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native-audio vs. img-to-video) and keep a live view of a fast-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time. Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available. Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass. Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one. Own the generative-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards. Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes. Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on-voice, on-persona, and matched beat-for-beat to the script (AV sync). Bring a direct-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good. Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline. Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales. Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self-serve the routine work. REQUIREMENTS 4+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables. A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished. Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed. Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi-subject-consistency image models, AI video (native-audio and img-to-video), lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade-offs, not just tool names. Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame. Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re-rolling until something lands. Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue. A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft. Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high-output content environment. Comfortable shipping many cuts and variants a week across multiple categories. Comfort working inside compliance rails (regulated-category claims, platform ad policy, partner brand guardrails). Strong collaboration across Creative, Production, Post, and Buying, and clear written communication for briefs, prompt docs, and learnings. Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a start-up style operating environment where the tools change under you. STRONG PLUSES Generative video that has run as paid social or DR creative with attributable performance, not only brand or experimental work. Concepting or copywriting experience on DR ads, so you can improve a script or angle, not just execute it. Direct experience generating for regulated DR categories and getting their renders through platform filters. Video editing or motion/VFX background

About the roleAbout the role. We are seeking a talented and innovative Ad Creative Producer to join the creative team of one of Ruby Labs’ fastest-growing consumer products, advertising at high volume on Meta, Snapchat, and Google. This full-time role is central to driving our advertising creative process. You will be responsible for producing high-quality ad creatives — both from briefs provided by the Lead Creative Producer and from your own ideas — managing production timelines, and collaborating with various teams to ensure that our creatives not only captivate but also convert. As a key player in the ad production lifecycle, you will work directly under the Lead Creative Producer and maintain close coordination with User Acquisition Managers to refine and optimize our creatives based on performance data.



Key Responsibilities

Creative Production & DevelopmentProduce high-quality ad creatives end-to-end — statics, video, and AI-generated formats — executing briefs from the Lead Creative Producer to a high standard.

Contribute your own ideas: lead the ideation and conceptualization of new ad creatives that resonate with diverse audiences, with an emphasis on strategies that enhance customer acquisition.

Stay ahead of industry trends to integrate innovative elements into creative production, ensuring our creatives are captivating and effectively convert viewers into customers.

Collaborate with the design team to transform ideas into compelling ad creatives that align with brand values and effectively meet campaign goals.

Project ManagementOversee your production pipeline to ensure all creatives are delivered on time and meet the creative vision, with particular attention to optimizing the impact on customer acquisition.

Coordinate with designers, the Lead Creative Producer, and User Acquisition Managers to ensure smooth workflow and high-quality outputs.

Performance AnalysisWork closely with User Acquisition Managers to analyze the performance of ad creatives across Meta, Snapchat, and Google, identifying those that best contribute to customer acquisition.

Provide regular reports to the Lead Creative Producer on the impact and effectiveness of ad creatives, highlighting their role in driving customer acquisition.

Market and Competitor AnalysisConduct thorough competitor research to understand market benchmarks and creative standards, particularly those successful in acquiring customers.

Identify emerging trends in ad creative production and propose innovative solutions to leverage these trends for better market positioning and customer engagement.

Collaborative EffortsLiaise between creative teams and User Acquisition Managers to ensure that ad creatives are optimized for performance based on real-time data.

Participate in brainstorming sessions that encourage a culture of creativity and continuous improvement, aimed at boosting customer acquisition and retention.





Qualifications

ExperienceProven hands-on experience producing ad creatives for Meta, Snapchat, and Google.

Proven track record of managing creative projects from inception to completion.

Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in producing high-performing digital ads.

Technical SkillsWorking knowledge of Meta and Google advertising policies — you know what content gets flagged (misleading design elements, restricted categories, prohibited claims) and produce creatives that stay compliant by default.

Expertise in digital advertising platforms and understanding of performance metrics.

Proficiency in project management tools and collaboration software.

Ability to perform data analysis to draw actionable insights from campaign results.

Up-to-date knowledge of AI tools used in creative production, with the ability to leverage them effectively to generate innovative ad creatives.

Personal QualitiesStrong creative vision with the ability to think out of the box and challenge the status quo.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage diverse teams and stakeholders.

Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

AdaptabilityAbility to quickly adapt to new technologies and changes in the digital marketing landscape.

Willingness to experiment with new creative ideas and approaches to advertising.
